messages:
priya: Quick check-in on comms for the recent inference timeout incident. Need owners for (A) 72h customer note, (B) public statuspage copy, (C) rules for RCA redaction. Who's volunteering?
sherman: I can do the statuspage copy. Will draft a short neutral blurb and ping ops for timestamps.
nana: small correction: my handle is ana (typo above) — I can take RCA redaction rules + coordinate with legal.
jack: I'll take 72h customer note draft. Plan: include impact summary, mitigation steps, and what we're doing next.
legal: Happy to review redaction decisions. Quick note: avoid verbatim error traces or any PII.
priya: Good. Timeline proposals: statuspage draft by +24h (sherman), 72h note draft by +48h (jack), redaction policy draft by +36h (ana) + legal review within 24h of that.
sherman: Example status copy (suggested):
```
We experienced intermittent increased latency affecting a subset of text-generation requests from 00:4002:05 UTC. The issue has been mitigated and we are monitoring for residual impact.
```
jack: +1 on wording. Suggest replace "intermittent" with "brief" in the first sentence to reduce ambiguity.
nana: For redaction checklist (initial):
- remove IP addresses
- redact exact customer IDs (show counts instead)
- no raw stack traces
- summarize third-party auth failures without naming tokens or endpoints
If a customer requests deeper logs, route to support + legal for controlled disclosure.
legal: Approved in principle. For any cross-customer aggregates, use rounded counts and do not link to timestamps tied to single-customer events.
priya: I'll open follow-up actions in the tracker:
- ACTION-2991: Draft statuspage copy (sherman) 1h
- ACTION-2992: Draft 72h customer note (jack) 2h
- ACTION-2993: RCA redaction checklist (ana) 6h
- ACTION-2994: Verification plan for deployed fix (sherman + infra) d
jack: Who verifies the fix post-deploy? I'd like SRE to own verification for 7 days (metrics + alerts).
sherman: Ops agrees to verification: infra will run synthetic checks and report daily for 7 days. I'll add that to ACTION-2994.
priya: Also flag: this incident looks related to the recent autoscaling regressions. Tagging as "recurring-pattern" and notifying platform-team. If it's recurring, we may need a specific customer note explaining mitigation roadmap.
nana: Good call. If platform asks for a short repeat-incidents summary, we should include last 3 incidents and planned mitigations. Keep that internal unless legal signs off.
incident-bot: Postmortem page created: https://redwood/pms/1755558000 (edit)
priya: OK — I'll consolidate drafts into the doc and assign reviewers. Please update the tracker when you start your action so we can hit the timelines. :thumbsup:
